ValidationRule.description: This validation rule is added for both Credit Card Application and Cash Collateral Cases
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( TEXT(Region_Flag__c) =='Bahrain', ($User.LastName <> "Integration"), OR( ISPICKVAL(cc_Credit_Evaluation_Result__c , "Accept"),ISPICKVAL( cc_HR_Result__c , "Approved") ), (cc_Approved_Credit_Limit__c < 300), OR( AND( ISPICKVAL( Type , "Credit Card Application"), ISPICKVAL(Sub_Type__c, 'New Credit Card') ), ISPICKVAL( Type , "Credit Card Cash Collateral Application"), ISPICKVAL(Type , "Convert Credit Card Nature Application") ) )
